text: Teaching Objective The program aims to set market as the principle and set different professional directions under this major, such as vehicle control, detection technology and instrument, test technology and information processing, technology of measurement and control and bilingual teaching etc, which are multiple choices and satisfy the need of career in society. Main Courses Circuit Principle Analog Electronic Technology Digital electronic technology Signals and systems Engineering drawing Automatic detection technology and instrument control system Internship Practice, course design, surveying and mapping practice, graduation practice, graduation design.
